tool_args.rationale: Eight labeled rows meet the stated minimum for fitting the four coupled-ODE parameters. The execution error came from fitting an unlabeled prediction row; this implementation fits once from train_rows, stores the numerical parameter estimate, and predicts new rows via RK4.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The batch already provided eight observations; the reported failure is an implementation bug, not an identifiability gap.
The endpoint-matched-history-gap and coupled-transient-lag signatures favor the coupled memory ODE over these simpler alternatives.
The prediction row contains no y field, so this caused the observed KeyError; fit is now performed on the labeled training set and parameters are retained for prediction.
